test_successful_auth_call: test the gRPC auth example by running a successful authenticated RPC call between client and server
test_no_channel_credential: test the gRPC auth example by verifying UNAVAILABLE status when using an insecure channel without credentials
test_no_call_credential: test the gRPC auth example by verifying UNAUTHENTICATED status when missing call credentials on a secure channel
test_asyncio_auth_call: test the gRPC auth example by running an async authenticated RPC call using asyncio
run_auth_example_tests: run all gRPC Python authentication example unit tests with verbose output using unittest
